actions.name: Open Velair's main pages
actions.checks: Open Overview, Schedules, Modes and Settings. Check that the panel fits the screen and shows no error notice.

variants.name: Main pages
variants.title: panel navigation and critical surfaces fit the viewport

steps.panel.open-pages: Opening and checking the main pages

actions.name: Edit and save a schedule
actions.checks: Use the temperature control, open and close help, then use the editor again. Save and reload a Monday temperature; preserve the other range bound and an untouched block.
actions.legacyChecks: Change one temperature in a Monday schedule, save it and reload the page. Confirm that the changed value is still stored.

variants.name: Heating
variants.title: heat schedule edits persist after a real save and reload

variants.name: Cooling
variants.title: cool schedule edits persist after a real save and reload

variants.name: Temperature range
variants.title: range schedule edits persist after a real save and reload

variants.name: Heating
variants.title: heat schedule controls remain usable and saved fields persist

variants.name: Cooling
variants.title: cool schedule controls remain usable and saved fields persist

variants.name: Temperature range
variants.title: range schedule controls remain usable and saved fields persist

steps.schedule.help-return: Closing help and using the editor again
steps.schedule.save: Saving and confirming the stored value
steps.schedule.reload: Reloading and checking the saved value

actions.name: Create and activate a profile
actions.checks: Create a profile and edit its zone schedule. Activate it and confirm the effective schedule and climate target, reload its content and selection, then return to the base schedule and target.
actions.legacyChecks: Create a named profile, select it as a base profile and reopen the page. Confirm that the profile remains in the list; activation after reload is not checked.

variants.name: Profile
variants.title: a profile can be created, edited, activated and reopened

variants.name: Effective profile
variants.title: a profile schedule applies to a climate and returns to the base schedule

steps.profile.reopen: Reopening and checking content and selection
steps.profile.restore-base: Restoring the base schedule and climate target

actions.name: Open and close schedule help
actions.checks: Open the help dialog from Schedules, check that it fits the screen and close it.

variants.name: Schedule help
variants.title: documentation dialog opens, fits and can be dismissed

steps.help.open: Opening and checking the help dialog

actions.name: Change temperature from the Lovelace card
actions.checks: Open the climate card, select Manual and increase the target temperature. Confirm that the simulated climate entity receives the change.

variants.name: Climate card
variants.title: committed frontend registers and controls a real Lovelace climate card

steps.card.open: Opening and checking the climate card
steps.card.change-temperature: Increasing and checking the target temperature

actions.name: Edit a schedule while another zone is offline
actions.checks: Make one climate entity unavailable, then change and save one temperature in another zone's schedule.

variants.name: Another zone offline
variants.title: an unavailable climate does not prevent editing another zone

steps.offline.edit-save: Editing and saving the available zone

actions.name: Keep a saved schedule after an HA restart
actions.checks: Restart the temporary Home Assistant instance, compare the saved schedule before and after, then open the Velair panel.

variants.name: Home Assistant restart
variants.title: saved schedule survives a Home Assistant restart

steps.restart.verify-schedule: Checking the saved schedule and opening Velair

actions.name: Use and save schedules during household activity
actions.checks: Keep an unsaved Monday temperature while a live climate update reaches the page. Then switch Overview/Schedules and edit/save while simulated lights, switches, covers and climate sensors change.
actions.legacyChecks: Switch between Overview and Schedules and edit/save one Monday temperature while simulated lights, switches, covers and climate sensors change.

measurements.name: Switch between Overview and Schedules
measurements.checks: Click an Overview or Schedules tab and wait for the requested page to appear.

measurements.name: Edit and confirm one saved temperature
measurements.checks: Change one Monday temperature, click Save and confirm the stored value.

steps.activity.keep-draft: Keeping an unsaved temperature while live climate updates arrive
steps.activity.edit-save: Editing and confirming a saved temperature

actions.name: Apply schedules when their time arrives
actions.checks: Wait for real Home Assistant schedule deadlines shared by heating, cooling and range climates. Check live modes and targets, one successful delivery per zone, then the following scheduled off action.

variants.name: Real schedule deadlines
variants.title: automatic schedules reach heating cooling and range climates at their real deadlines

steps.execution.before-deadline: Checking that targets do not apply early
steps.execution.targets: Checking automatic delivery at the target deadline
steps.execution.off: Checking the following automatic off deadline

actions.name: Keep Manual control and resume the current schedule
actions.checks: Change a climate target in Manual, change its automatic schedule and confirm the manual target holds. Resume while an independent pause remains without sending a target; remove only that pause and confirm the current schedule applies.

variants.name: Manual and independent pause
variants.title: Manual survives schedule changes and Automatic respects an independent pause

steps.manual.enter: Entering Manual and changing the target
steps.manual.hold: Keeping the manual target after an automatic intention changes
steps.manual.resume-paused: Resuming Automatic while respecting an independent pause
steps.manual.resume-current: Applying the current schedule after the test pause ends

actions.name: Keep an edited schedule after a rejected save
actions.checks: Keep the exact unsaved temperature after another editor changes configuration and the stale save is rejected. Show an error without success, preserve stored schedules, then deliberately reopen and save against the current revision.

variants.name: Concurrent edit conflict
variants.title: a rejected stale schedule save keeps its draft and can be recovered

steps.save-recovery.concurrent-change: Saving a concurrent change from another editor
steps.save-recovery.reject-without-data-loss: Rejecting the stale save without losing draft or stored data
steps.save-recovery.reopen-and-save: Deliberately reopening and saving the current revision

actions.name: Velair open at rest
actions.checks: Keep the Velair page open without generated device activity. This measures background resources, not a user interaction.

actions.name: Other devices changing while Velair stays open
actions.checks: Change simulated lights, switches and covers while the Velair page stays open. No clicks or schedule edits are performed in this condition.

actions.name: A burst of device updates
actions.checks: Keep Velair open during a burst of simulated device updates and the following recovery window. No user interaction is measured here.

actions.name: Review selected screens in both themes
actions.checks: Capture Overview, the schedule editor and a dialog in light and dark themes. Captures alone are not an approved visual comparison and do not establish backend scheduling behavior.

variants.name: Selected screens
variants.title: selected screens have explicit visual evidence in both themes
